nonfinite_input.note: C++-style min/max ordering maps NaN/Inf inputs to the finite hard ceiling. This is an observation, not a robustness endorsement.

peak_overshoot.note: Level bursts can demand more gain reduction than the 8 Hz log-domain smoother can apply immediately; the hard ceiling is the observable guard.

silence_handling.note: Silence drives the envelope to zero and the desired gain to its 18 dB bound with zero output; raising gain during pauses is a known risk.

unreached_recovery.reason: Gain did not return to the quiet reference within the fixed-length fixture.

delay.note: Per-sample causal AGC plus hard ceiling; content delay is not availability latency or acoustic phase/group delay.

interacting_nonlinear.note: Static sequence chaining through the adapter boundary only; agc_then_limiter is expected to equal agc_only when the AGC ceiling already keeps every sample below the limiter ceiling. No native chain, real-time interaction or listening claim.

load_and_gain_step_control.note: Load-specific gain-step tracking proxy only. Not STOI, SI-SDR, intelligibility, listening, CPU load or deadline evidence.
load_and_gain_step_control.stimulus: deterministic harmonic-burst synthetic speech with +/-9 dB gain steps

response.note: Chirp band RMS ratios are nonlinear response summaries, not a linear transfer function.

gain_smoothing_section.note: First-order bilinear-transformed lowpass in the log-gain domain.

task_board.note: Read-time snapshot only; never a qualification or gating source.
